bio: For a comfortingly classical experience, head to the Stikliai Hotel in the heart of the Old Town, where photos of famous faces who have visited over the years line the walls. Nestled within its former courtyard is an elegant, glass-roofed restaurant filled with greenery, where beautifully presented, classical French dishes are a perfect match for the atmosphere. Both the sauces and desserts are a highlight – the Angus steak comes with an intense red wine jus, while the likes of fresh mango and passion fruit with French meringue, coconut ice cream and mascarpone cream linger long in the memory....
